remarks: HIGHEST AND BEST DUE BY SATURDAY DEC 6TH 5PM. Welcome to this inviting four-bedroom high ranch home, perfectly situated on a quiet cul-de-sac just minutes from town. Thoughtfully maintained and updated, this residence offers modern comforts, flexible living spaces, and an unbeatable location. The main level includes a spacious family room with wood burning fireplace and a first-floor bedroom with a full bath, providing excellent versatility for guests, in-laws, or a home office. Walk upstairs to the beautifully renovated eat-in kitchen featuring crisp finishes and direct access to a screened-in porch and open deck, ideal for morning coffee or warm-weather entertaining. The upstairs also boasts a primary bedroom, two additional bedrooms, a formal dining room, and an expansive living room filled with natural light-perfect for gatherings and everyday living. This home has been freshly painted and boasts numerous recent upgrades, including new Hardie siding, new windows, a new generator, and a new furnace. A 2-car garage and professionally landscaped grounds complete with irrigation system add to its appeal. The beautiful, level backyard offers exceptional outdoor enjoyment. Ideally located, this home is just a short walk to Kiwanis Park, minutes to town, and provides an easy commute to the Merritt Parkway or the train station. Located on a picture-perfect cul-de-sac in an ideal neighborhood, this adorable New Canaan home is waiting for you!
